canonical_title: Longitudinal control power throughout speed range

versions.title_at_revision: Longitudinal control power throughout speed range
versions.text:
Standard: The air vehicle longitudinal control power does not limit the ability to attain and hold any speed from Vs to Vmax in steady 1g flight at any altitude within the ROTH. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess control power required to achieve pitch trim from Vs to Vmax in steady 1g flight in the ROTH as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Power in Unaccelerated Flight paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess control power required to achieve pitch trim from Vs to Vmax in steady 1g flight within the ROTH as specified in MIL- STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Power in Unaccelerated Flight paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess control power required to achieve pitch trim from Vs to Vmax in steady 1g flight within the ROTH as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Power in Unaccelerated Flight paragraph for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
